NBA DFS Rankings for Thursday, October 22 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, October 22 · 2 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 22, 9:16 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) ranks first on the Thursday, October 22 DraftKings main slate at 58.4 projected DraftKings points for $10,900. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 50.5) and Joel Embiid (PHI, 44.2) are next.

The table ranks all 51 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 22, 9:16 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
